notes.title: More interactions! Qiu Qiu Town Story 0.15 Objective
notes.content:
1. Scooter function realization: usage, scene switching
2. Put vehicles in the backpack
3. Scooters of different colors
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/de81360a8bce61f93309ecbcd6b1809fa687ae77.png[/img]

4. Description of existing items
5. Items can be placed in the box in advance
6. Player life choice interface: Two options, villager and township-resident
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/4a1671bef691b78c9c3ca2ab70f6f4c54befc734.png[/img]

7. Increase restrictions on houses. Other people's houses cannot be entered within the specified time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/bc7d38b072ebf7f0d72ef58d7353fb8285412b77.png[/img]

8. Increase the camera's movement boundary
9. Add a lock-picking mini-game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/9a9756f555caa4b03d293b6133143e6b2bec407d.png[/img]

10. More item interactions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45385946/977522baebc70cd9fdabfe343aa4c9ae07f34605.png[/img]
